body:
The font size change is a workaround, but I'd much prefer not to have the icon size and font size linked. Font/icon size changes don't take effect until restart: they should take effect immediately on changing the value, or at least after pressing OK on the dialog -- or is that a java thing?

Also, the options dialog doesn't scale with the font; seems to be pixel-based rather than em.

When I looked last time changing the font and icon sizes dynamically proved too hard.
However we did manage to get the Look&Feel to change dynamically, so it might be possible.
There are quite a few dialogs that dont scale with the font - I've been meaning to address these for some time but no one else has complained so it wasnt high on my list - I use it for demos when sharing my screen but I wasnt sure if anyone else had hit this...
